---
name: Bug
about: Something that worked, or should work, behaves wrongly
type: Bug
---

## Summary

<!--
Two to four plain sentences: what goes wrong, what should happen instead, and
who notices it (users, admins, operators). Describe behavior, not code: no file
paths, links to files, or function names. Keep Summary, Impact, and Evidence
under 150 words together.
-->

## Impact

<!--
One line: what happens if this is left alone, and how soon it matters. Say so
if it can make stored data, verification, or ratings wrong.
-->

## Evidence

<!--
How you know: what you observed, the steps to see it again, and where it shows
up, such as a page, an API endpoint, a workflow, or an operation. Say what you
have not confirmed.
-->

## Recommendations

<!--
One or more proposed solutions, as a numbered list. For each, say in one or two
sentences what would change and what it costs or risks. Put the one you would
pick first and say why. Describe the approach, not code: no file paths or
function names. Say what you have not checked.
-->
